title: Piercing L2-1
source: Port-authored setup from Tools/puzzles/generate_puzzles.py template 'piercing', level 2, variant 1. The line uses engine-supported cards but is not a GBA fixed-board reconstruction.
notes: Spear Dragon's built-in piercing damage, boosted by the equipped cards, deals exact battle damage to the Defense Position monster.

canon_reference.setup_status: canon setup unavailable; this file uses a port-authored template
solution_steps: Special Summon Lava Golem by tributing two Sheep Tokens.
Special Summon the other Lava Golem by tributing the Lava Golem you summoned before and one Sheep Token.
Activate Change of Heart and select Lava Golem.
Equip Axe of Despair on Lava Golem.
Enter Battle Phase and destroy the Sheep Token with Summoned Skull.
